name: OmaBoot? Live
line: A stripped-down omarchy-iso with just the essentials, plus the OmaBoot? test suite: test your Mac against the official Omarchy environment. Built to run on Macs with 2 GB of RAM, straight off the USB stick.

name: OmaBoot? Omarchy
line: The full Omarchy installer plus the OmaBoot? test suite. The way to test first, then commit to installing Omarchy from the same stick. One stick to rule them all!

name: OmaBoot? Slim
line: A two-stick option: the official Omarchy ISO stays on one stick, and the tiny OmaBoot? test suite on a second loads itself before the system starts.
